mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( review_no, product_id, user_no, user_id, content, created_date, evaluation ) VALUES ( review_no_seq.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{userNo}, #{userId}, #{content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{evaluation} )
mapper.select: SELECT pd.product_id, pd.product_count, pd.product_color, pd.store_location, p.product_name, -- ✅ product_name 추가 p.product_image, p.product_price FROM product_detail pd JOIN product p ON pd.product_id = p.product_id WHERE pd.product_id = #{productId}
SELECT stock FROM product WHERE product_no = #{productNo}
